label: Whatever has the nine is LIVING_2, from every POTENCY_1-free being being LIVING_2 (inference)
rule: Restriction of a universal premise to a subclass of its antecedent: the sixth of the nine is pure act
meaning: Strength order registration: STMT-PURE-ACT-LIVES (every pure act lives at some time of the duration frame) entails its nine-restricted version, since the altogether-immutable conjunct of the nine is by definition being in potency in no respect. Projection and application only; it establishes neither version.
